change.title: Production Readiness Semantics
change.defect: The CLX-016 readiness endpoint required production traffic to be OFF, causing a healthy controlled live runtime to report ready=false after traffic cutover.
change.fix: Separate infrastructure readiness, external-execution safety, and traffic mode. Readiness now remains true for a healthy approved database with live providers and real money OFF whether traffic is LOCKED or LIVE.
change.api_contract: Additive/compatible: existing readiness keys retained; infrastructure_ready, external_execution_safe and traffic_mode added.
